description: Suijin v3.5.0: THE KERNEL LANDS (Phase 1 core) — contracts (Module/Tool protocols, tiers), EventBus (per-subscriber fault isolation), Context (the syscall table: services/tools/events), Registry (manifest DAG with cycle-naming, collision policy, quarantine), controller.boot() (quiet-boot scene analysis), plus the kernel-purity linter. Stdlib-only, 45 kernel tests. Remaining subsystems (jobs/vfs/security/config/health/journal) absorb legacy twins next.
